_comment: WebXR scene = Jardin des Tuileries (webxr-worldmodels.vercel.app). It has exactly THREE Gaussian-splat sculptures, all by Aristide Maillol: Air (the default splat on load), La Nuit, and L'Hommage à Cézanne. Sophie only needs to identify these three here. The frontend sends the current splat's identifier (filename, URL, slug, or short name) as the `splat` field on POST /ask; the backend maps it to an exhibit id below. Matching is case-, accent-, and punctuation-insensitive, ignores URL paths and splat extensions (.splat/.ply/.ksplat/.spz), and every exhibit id + display name is ALSO accepted automatically. To wire a real splat filename, add "my_splat_filename": "exhibit_id". (Other Louvre exhibits still resolve by id/name for the camera-scan flow, but are not part of this scene.)
